name: Kasugano Mariko
source:
She's been classmates with the protagonist since middle school and has been friends with [url=/c73423]Natsukawa Kyouko[/url] since she was young.
She's bad with males other than the protagonist and doesn't talk much.
She's good at looking after people and is always fussing over the protagonist.
She puts all her effort into her contract with her partner spirit Mari.
